apps.title: Connected Apps
apps.apiKeyShown: API Key (shown once — copy it now)
apps.inboundSecretConfirm: Generate an inbound secret? Set it on the app (Obliance, Oblimap, Oblihub: OBLIGATE_INBOUND_SECRET), restart the app, then click Activate: Obligate switches to it only once the app accepts it.
apps.inboundSecretClearConfirm: Remove the inbound secret? Obligate will present the API key again when it calls this app.
apps.inboundSecretShown: Inbound secret (shown once — copy it now, set it on the app, restart the app, then click Activate)
apps.inboundSecretSetHint: Obligate presents a distinct inbound secret (not the API key) when it calls this app
apps.noApps: No connected apps yet. Click "Add App" to register one.
apps.syncFailedHelp: These apps could not be told about a password, two-factor or activation change for 24 hours. Only Obliance re-checks the credentials at each sensitive use; in the other apps, the sessions opened before the change stay open until they expire. Check that the app is reachable at its base URL and that its API key (or inbound secret) is current, then retry.
apps.inboundSecretPendingHint: Generated, not in use yet: set it on the app, then click Activate
apps.inboundSecretActivate: Activate the inbound secret (Obligate checks that the app accepts it)
apps.inboundSecretActivated: Inbound secret active: the app accepted it.
apps.inboundSecretRefused: The app did not accept the secret (HTTP {{status}}): set it on the app, restart it, then activate again. Obligate keeps using the previous credential.
apps.inboundSecretUnreachable: The app could not be reached at its base URL. Obligate keeps using the previous credential.
apps.inboundSecretUnsupported: This app cannot be configured with an inbound secret: it only accepts its API key from Obligate.
apps.deleteConfirm: Delete this app? Its user links, group mappings, device links and preferences are deleted with it.
apps.regenerateConfirm: Regenerate the API key? The old key stops working immediately: set the new one on the app right away.
apps.baseUrlInvalid: Invalid base URL: an absolute http(s) URL without credentials, query or fragment.
apps.baseUrlHelp: The address users open the app at (scheme, host and port exactly): Obligate only sends sign-ins back to this origin.
apps.keyExposedHelp: This app sent its API key in clear as its sign-in client_id (last {{date}}, {{count}}×): the key went through browsers and must be treated as public. No delegation token is issued for it. Make the app send sha256(key), then regenerate the key.

users.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this user?
users.errorGroupRequired: You must select at least one group.
users.outOfScopeAction: Out of your scope — this user belongs to a group you don't manage

activity.twoFactorResetPendingHint: Two-factor authentication was reset — the user must configure a new authenticator at their next login
activity.noAppLogins: No SSO logins to any app yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.minPasswordLengthHelp: Enforced on user creation and password change
settings.force2faDescription: Require all users to set up 2FA. New users will configure it during enrollment, existing users on next login. A permission group can be individually exempted in Permission Groups.
settings.smtpDescription: Configure an SMTP server to enable email-based 2FA (OTP by email). If not configured, only TOTP (authenticator app) is available.
settings.smtpTestHelp: Uses the values shown above (does not require saving first).
